name: vLLM_GLM53_Flash_PUBLIC_TEMPLATE
onstart:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "[glm53] onstart: provisioning model from R2, then vllm serve"
PROV="${PROVISIONING_SCRIPT:?PROVISIONING_SCRIPT env is required}"
curl -fsSL "$PROV" -o /opt/glm53-provision.sh
chmod +x /opt/glm53-provision.sh
exec /opt/glm53-provision.sh
desc: GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next, 321B/18B-active MoE, multimodal) FP8 on vllm/vllm-openai:glm53-flash. R2-synced model, TP sized per launch profile. Requires vLLM 0.29+ / FlashInfer >=0.6.17 (bundled in the image).
